Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the comparison of birth years, incorrectly treating a smaller birth year as “younger.” Although the gathered data were correct (Curtis Bernhardt: 1899; Emile Ardolino: 1943), the Planner reversed the logic and concluded Torments of the Night had the younger director, when in fact Dirty Dancing’s director (Ardolino) is younger.
